questions: Do you have any trouble breathing or shortness of breath right now?
Do you have a fever or chills right now, or did you recently have them?
Do you have any shortness of breath or fast breathing when you walk around, and what is your oxygen saturation if it has been measured?
Do you have any wheezing or abnormal breath sounds, or have you been able to produce phlegm/sputum when coughing?
Do you have any chest pain that is tender to touch or worsens when you press on the painful area (i.e., is it reproducible with palpation)?
Have you had any recent chest trauma or heavy lifting that could have strained or injured the chest wall (including coughing-related rib injury)?
What is your current heart rate and oxygen saturation (SpO₂) measured now in the clinic?
Have you had any episodes of fainting, coughing up blood, or one-sided leg swelling/pain recently?
Have you noticed any recent shortness of breath that is worse on one side, or any sudden increase in pain with coughing that happens with a feeling of “can’t get a full breath”?
Have you had a recent chest X-ray or ECG, and if so what were the results?
answers: Right now I don’t feel short of breath, but the pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply. I’ve had intense coughing fits too.
No, I don’t have a fever or chills right now, and I haven’t had them recently.
No, I don’t have trouble breathing when I walk around—just the chest pain, and it’s worse with movement and when I breathe in. I don’t know my oxygen saturation; it hasn’t been measured for me yet.
I don’t know about wheezing or abnormal breath sounds—no one has told me that. When I cough, I can sometimes bring up phlegm, but I’m mostly dealing with the pain from the coughing fits.
Yes, it’s painful when I move, and it feels worse with touch on the chest wall area—like a sharp, knife-stroke kind of pain. The back right side also hurts more when I press there.
No trauma or heavy lifting that I remember. But I’ve had intense coughing fits, and that kind of pain feels like it started really fast, like within minutes.
I don’t know my heart rate or oxygen saturation right now. No one has told me those numbers yet.
No fainting, and I’m not coughing up blood. I also haven’t noticed one-sided leg swelling or leg pain.
No, my breathing doesn’t feel worse on just one side. The pain does get worse when I cough, but it’s more like sharp pain/pleuritic pain than a “can’t get a full breath” feeling.
No, I haven’t had a chest X-ray or an ECG yet.
